question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

339, 340, 348, ?, 439
solution:
**Logic :** Consecutive series of cube are added to each number subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bb8b7cf1cae51fd485cdc5fb83ba135d99e30bf535e178602e7dcfa762689de.png] 

Hence, **"375"** is the correct answer.
